model: EasyOCR english_g2, fine-tuned last BiLSTM/linear layers on supplied screenshot room crops

input.name: image
input.normalization: grayscale / 127.5 - 1; preserve aspect, white/right pad, image padded by 4 pixels before resize

output.name: logits
output.decode: greedy CTC; ASCII alphanumeric and hyphen only, uppercase result; no room dictionary

deploymentStatus: Integrated in browser UI with onnxruntime-web 1.22.0 WASM CPU, single-thread inside Web Worker. Canvas resize differs from Pillow; Python parity is not browser parity.
license: Based on EasyOCR pretrained english_g2, Apache-2.0; see training/README.md
